name: Network Management Agent (NMA)
description: A second, more institutionally backed IETF draft alongside NCFED: co-authored across CAICT, China Mobile, Huawei, Cisco, and ZTE, now on its fifth revision. Proposes a Network Management Agent that works alongside existing controllers rather than replacing them, aimed explicitly at reaching TM Forum's Level 4 autonomy, with four defined interface types for agent-to-user, agent-to-agent, agent-to-controller, and agent-to-network communication.
